name: Junior data analysts
oneLiner: The role that proves the entry level is being redesigned rather than deleted.
why: AI-exposed junior roles redesigned to demand senior skills are growing
Interpretation and framing of a result is now the visible half of the work
threats: Globally, entry-level postings in highly AI-exposed roles have flatlined
49% of CEOs expect AI adoption to reduce junior hiring in the next three years

metrics.label: CEO expectation of less junior hiring

claims.text: Entry-level roles that now require more than ten traditionally senior skills are growing at 35%, while other entry-level roles decline.

The most AI-exposed entry-level roles are seven times more likely than the least exposed to demand traditionally senior skills such as leadership, strategic decision-making and stakeholder management.
49% of CEOs expect AI adoption to decrease junior hiring over the next three years, against 12% for senior hiring.
